title: McpServerPreview
description: `POST /engines/:engine/mcp-servers/preview`: the description a save of this configuration would show and record — word for word (plan 13, B-18, S-68). `params` is a map of strings: the generator has no number type here, so a numeric field (such as a count) travels as its decimal text, the way `costUsd` already does elsewhere.

params.description: Every value a string — a numeric field (a count) travels as its decimal text, the way `costUsd` already does elsewhere. Open: shaped by the server's transport.
